title: Spaghettifying DRAM
summary: A security research project by the MDS (Microarchitectural Data Sampling) researcher focusing on DRAM manipulation techniques, likely related to Rowhammer-style hardware vulnerability exploitation. The 'bath salts' naming follows the tradition of Rowhammer-related research names (Throwhammer, Half-Double, etc.).
problem_solved: Exploits and analyzes hardware-level memory vulnerabilities in DRAM through techniques like Rowhammer attacks.
why_valuable: Advances understanding of physical memory security vulnerabilities that affect millions of devices at the hardware level.
